name: Read Lines (Kraken lines, vision model)
description: Use this when: you want Kraken to find each written line on the page and a vision model to read each line it found (the line reader): Kraken's own baselines and outlines carry the model's text, so the result is a line-by-line pass a person can correct and a Kraken reader can be trained on. The vision model is the run's model (a recipe's reading step names it). Install the Kraken runtime first (Settings → AI → Local Inference); a cloud model sends each line's picture to its provider.

nodes.label: Kraken lines, read by the vision model
